hook: An AMD graphics card just got much faster at AI.
hookText: AMD cards run AI much faster

beats.say: A lean, small patch set applies AMD-specific improvements on top of llama cpp, and it is re-applied to every new version.
On the author's own setup, prefill jumped from about seven hundred to thirteen hundred tokens a second.
Token generation rose too, from thirty-five to fifty-five tokens a second, with a ready-made container image to run it yourself.
